_metadata.last_instruction: Fill in all fields below. Fields that can be skipped should have contents deleted and left as empty string or empty array.

role: Choose from: Web Developer, Graphic Designer, Social Media Manager, Video Editor, Creative Director, Content Strategist, UX/UI Designer, Brand Designer, Digital Marketing Manager, Account Manager, Automation Engineer
skill: Choose from: HTML/CSS/JS, Python, JavaScript, React, Webflow, Framer, Figma, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Lottie, Make.com, Notion, GitHub Pages, Jekyll, Git, Midjourney, Claude/Cursor, Generative AI, Adobe Firefly, Illustration, Animation, Motion Graphics, Typography, Print Layout, Photography, Product Staging, Copywriting, SEO, Analytics, A/B Testing, Responsive Design, CSS Animation, Landing Page Design, Data Visualization, Dashboard Design, Voice Interface, E-Commerce, CMS Management, No-Code, Automation, API Integration, Scaling Systems, Art Direction, Editorial Design, Lookbook Design, Video Production, Content Production, Publishing

media.video_url: https://youtu.be/XXXXXXXXXXX  ← Leave empty if no video
media.video_embed: <iframe ...>  ← YouTube/Behance embed code, replace double quotes with single
media.video_alt_text: Descriptive alt text for the video content
media.thumb_slideshow_alt_text: Descriptive alt text for slideshow thumbnails

teaser_copy.page_title: Display title on the entry page
tile_text: First tile text (shown on section page tiles)

page_copy.pattern: THE CHALLENGE: What problem needed solving? What was the context? 2-4 sentences describing the situation before this project.
page_copy.action: THE APPROACH: What was done? How was it tackled? 2-4 sentences about the work itself — tools used, decisions made, execution details.
page_copy.measured: THE OUTCOME: What happened? What were the results? 2-4 sentences about impact, metrics, or what was learned.
